value.reason: Knowledge chunk directly answers where to find invoices for completed payments.

groundedReply.suggestedResponse: You can download your invoice by going to Billing and then Payment history. Invoices become available once a payment reaches a completed state, so as long as your payment has completed, you should find it listed there with a download option. Note that pending payments do not yet have a final invoice available.

citations.section: Invoices and payments > Finding an invoice
citations.claim: Invoices are found in Billing under Payment history and are available once a payment is completed; pending payments do not have a final invoice.
